svg.aria-label: maskwire demo: personal data masked before the upstream and restored for the client
svg.text: $ make demo
=== 1. OpenAI JSON through semantic-cache-gateway (expect cache MISS)
client sent : Customer support ticket: please draft a short and polite reply to the customer at
ana.souza@correio.pt about the refund for order 7731, her CPF is 529.982.247-25 and the refund
goes to IBAN PT50 0002 0123 1234 5678 9015 4 within five working days.
status : 200 masked=3 restored=3 cache=MISS

[EMAIL_FBDYD9] about the refund for order 7731, her CPF is [CPF_A0SA1Q] and the refund goes to
IBAN [IBAN_7TCYYA] within five working days.

ana.souza@correio.pt about the refund for order 7731, her CPF is 529.982.247-25 and the refund
goes to IBAN PT50 0002 0123 1234 5678 9015 4 within five working days.
